models.name: Constant-product AMM (x * y = k)
invariants: reserve0 * reserve1 does not decrease after a swap once fees are accounted
spot price is reserve1/reserve0 and is single-block manipulable
first mint must lock MINIMUM_LIQUIDITY forever
hazards: Using spot price as an oracle
Donations that change k without minting shares
models.safe_pattern: k_after >= k_before * (1 - fee)^2; liquidity burned to address(0) on first mint.

models.name: StableSwap invariant
invariants: D is non-decreasing after balanced operations
A (amplification) changes must be gradual
hazards: Instant A changes enable value extraction
Rounding in get_y favoring the swappers
models.safe_pattern: Ramp A over days; lock virtual price during external calls.

models.name: ERC-4626 share / asset conversion
invariants: shares = assets * (totalSupply + offset) / (totalAssets + offset)
mint rounds in favor of the vault; redeem rounds in favor of the vault
empty vault cannot be inflated by donation
models.safe_pattern: Virtual shares/assets (OpenZeppelin ERC4626) or burned dead shares.

models.name: Index / accumulator interest
invariants: Every balance-changing action accrues first
Index is monotonic
Index cannot overflow for the intended lifetime
models.safe_pattern: accrue() as the first statement of every state-changing entry.

models.name: Lending health factor
invariants: HF = collateral * price * LT / debt * price
Liquidation only when HF < 1
Close factor and incentive leave a safety buffer
models.safe_pattern: Fresh independent oracle, close factor < 100%, no self-liquidation.

models.name: Weighted / Balancer-style pool
invariants: Product of reserve_i ^ weight_i is preserved after fees
Weights sum to 1e18
models.safe_pattern: Balancer Vault reentrancy lock observed by all pools.

models.name: Perpetual funding rate
invariants: Mark is not a single-block spot
Funding cannot be forced by a flash move of mark
models.safe_pattern: TWAP mark, funding clamps, sequencer-uptime pause.

models.name: Concentrated-liquidity tick / sqrtPrice
invariants: Active liquidity increases by at most the minted amount when a tick is crossed
sqrtP == TickMath.getSqrtRatioAtTick(t) is a first-class case, not an off-by-one
Fee growth is not added twice on a boundary cross
hazards: Double-add of liquidity when price sits exactly on a tick (KyberSwap Elastic)
Using a CLAMM spot as a same-block oracle
Spoof tokens with empty ticks moving an internal price curve
models.safe_pattern: Fuzz exact-tick mint+cross; refuse unknown tokens as price inputs.

models.name: Donation / reserve transfer vs account health
invariants: Any reduction in collateral or equity runs the same solvency check as withdraw
Reserves cannot be credited from an undercollateralized account
Self-liquidation cannot extract a bonus after a donation
hazards: Donation used to inflate a share or exchange rate
models.safe_pattern: donate() calls the canonical requireHealthy / checkAccountStatus path.

models.name: Harvest reward as balance delta
invariants: Credited rewards equal a trusted interface return, not a raw balance delta
A re-entrant deposit cannot increase credited rewards
hazards: before = balanceOf; untrusted.redeem(); reward = balanceOf - before (Penpie)
Permissionless market supplies the redeem target
models.safe_pattern: Trusted reward amount + nonReentrant covering harvest and deposit.
